strengths.title: Tamper-evident cryptographic audit ledger and sovereign local proxy
strengths.preserve: Maintain the SHA-256 chained audit ledger and fail-closed local policy proxy in desktop/src/sentinel.rs and src/sentinel/ledger/

strengths.title: Deterministic 7-gate security release pipeline

findings.title: Unescaped user commit message inserted into innerHTML in prompt git options view
findings.impact: Crafted commit messages containing HTML tags will execute in the extension options page context when rendered in the history list.
findings.fix: Use escapeHtml(c.message) or assign c.message directly to textContent on a dedicated text node.

findings.title: Automated secret scanning is not wired into the CI/CD pipeline
findings.impact: Accidental check-in of API tokens, private keys, or credentials will not be blocked prior to merge or release tagging.
findings.fix: Add a blocking Gitleaks or Trufflehog scanning step in .github/workflows/ci.yml and require zero unmasked findings.

findings.title: Repository lacks a standardized STATE.md build state record and formalized ADR directory
findings.impact: Architectural decisions and build session progression lack standardized machine-readable state tracking.
findings.fix: Add docs/STATE.md recording current build phase and formalize architectural decision records.

findings.title: Repository working directory carries unstaged local modifications
findings.impact: Uncommitted diffs in content.js and release manifest can produce non-reproducible build outputs across developer environments.
findings.fix: Commit or stash all tracked modifications and verify that git status --porcelain reports a clean state before release packaging.

tasks.title: Sanitize commit message rendering in prompt git options viewer
tasks.reuses: textContent or local HTML escape helper
acceptance: c.message is rendered via textContent or through an explicit escapeHtml call.
HTML elements like render as literal strings without DOM insertion.

tasks.title: Wire automated secret scanning gate into GitHub Actions CI pipeline
acceptance: A blocking Gitleaks scan runs on push to main and all pull requests in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Commits introducing unredacted secrets fail the pipeline immediately.

tasks.title: Formalize repository build state in docs/STATE.md and architectural records
acceptance: A documented docs/STATE.md exists outlining completed phases and current release milestone.
Architectural trade-offs for local wasm and native bridge are catalogued.
godaudits validation confirms the presence of session-state artifacts.

tasks.title: Reconcile and commit modified working tree state
tasks.reuses: git commit workflow and release gate verification
acceptance: All working tree modifications are reviewed and committed with clear commit messages.
Deterministic build hashes are regenerated and match git HEAD.
git status --porcelain reports an empty working tree.
